verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents a public API that lets users programmatically manage datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments and API keys, and it publishes a downloadable OpenAPI spec. The probe's 404s were on different candidate paths, not the documented /api/openapi-public.yaml, so they do not contradict the docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the REST API (community evidence only covers the MCP server).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Build integrations and automate workflows with the Honeycomb API. Programmatically manage datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments, API keys, and more.
The Honeycomb API gives you programmatic access to manage resources, automate workflows, and integrate Honeycomb into your systems.
You can [download the Honeycomb OpenAPI spec](/api/openapi-public.yaml) to use with your own tooling.
